inputs.rationale: WS0.5 wire probe: client asked to increase the equipment facility.

warnings: Execution is available. This facility is booked and open, which is what a credit action requires, so execute_loan_modification will run this plan behind the decision token.

This plans a modification, NOT an approval. Executing it produces a clone facility at Qualification; BOOKING that clone requires nCino's Submit for Approval button, which Loan_Validation_06 enforces with no permission bypass.

The junction object has no validation rules, no triggers and no flows, so a malformed row would fail silently. Execution therefore verifies the clone and its chain row by re-query and claims nothing the org will not read back.
The platform is known to produce duplicate modification loans on failed background Apex, so idempotency is enforced by this tool rather than assumed.
No loan-level covenants are attached to this facility, so nothing would carry over.
result.summary: Plans a modification of ZZ-WS05-PROBE Borrower - Equipment - $1,000,000.00 on the package. nCino will clone the facility, create the chain junction row and apply the requested changes to the clone. NOTHING IS WRITTEN BY THIS CALL: staging computes and holds the plan, and execute_loan_modification runs it behind the decision token. Executing this plan creates the modification at Qualification and stops there. Booking it is nCino's own run: Submit for Approval with real approvers, which Loan_Validation_06 enforces with no permission bypass.
